# MCP Sales Agent

> Model Context Protocol (MCP) native sales intelligence framework.
> Next.js 15 + TypeScript. Zero-config demo mode. n8n integration orchestrator. Hermes Agent cron skills.

## What This Is

An MCP server that exposes sales tools (call analysis, pipeline updates, follow-up drafting, benchmarks) as typed tools any MCP host can discover and invoke. Includes an observability dashboard.

## For AI Agents

- **Quick start:** `git clone <repo> && cd agentic-sales-engine && npm install && cp .env.example .env && npm run dev`
- **MCP server:** `npx ts-node src/mcp/server.ts`
- **Architecture:** `AGENTS.md`
- **Agent skills:** `.claude/skills/mcp-sales-agent/SKILL.md` (Hermes/Claude/Codex), `.kimi/skills/mcp-sales-agent/SKILL.md` (Kimi), `.opencode/skills/mcp-sales-agent/SKILL.md` (Opencode)
- **Cron jobs:** `.claude/skills/mcp-sales-agent/cron/*/SKILL.md`

## Key Files

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `src/mcp/server.ts` | MCP stdio server — tool registry + handlers |
| `src/lib/n8n/client.ts` | n8n webhook client — all integrations proxy through here |
| `src/lib/agent/analyzer.ts` | Analysis engine with SSE streaming |
| `src/lib/demo/` | Mock data for zero-config demo |
| `n8n/workflows/` | Pre-built workflow JSON templates |
| `prisma/schema.prisma` | PostgreSQL schema |
| `src/app/api/` | REST + SSE endpoints |

## Tools

- `analyze_call` — sentiment, objections, talk ratios
- `update_pipeline` — move deal stage
- `draft_followup` — post-call email
- `get_benchmarks` — industry comparison

## Integration Ecosystem

Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, Slack, Gmail, Google Calendar, Outlook, CalendarFuel, Apollo, Pipedrive, Fathom, Fireflies.

All managed through n8n workflows. Demo mode works without API keys or n8n.

## Commands

```bash
npm install       # deps
npm run dev       # dev server @ localhost:3000
npm test          # jest
npm run typecheck # tsc --noEmit
npx ts-node src/mcp/server.ts  # MCP stdio
make docker-up    # full stack (postgres + n8n + app)
```
